name: input
title: Input
description: Single-line text field for use inside Field. 44px tall, 16px text, visible focus ring and an invalid state that does not rely on color alone.
docs: Akso UI Input: use it inside <Field> with a <FieldLabel>, and set type and autoComplete. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
